name: Muhammad Ahmed
university: NED University of Engineering and Technology
title: Game Developer | Computer Science Student
tagline: Building games, XR worlds and data-driven tools.
bio: Muhammad Ahmed is a BS Computer Science & IT student at NED University (2023-2027, CGPA 3.515) who is passionate about making games and working with data. He builds games and XR experiences in Unity and C#, a React Native health app, and a flood-simulation final year project. He won GameCon with the co-op game Two Lights One Escape, placed 3rd at Global Game Jam with Sound Mask, completed the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, and is open to internship opportunities.
